```{r}
set.seed(42)
quiet_output <- TRUE
quiet_cat <- function(...) {
  if (!quiet_output) cat(...)
}

n_detected_cores <- tryCatch(parallel::detectCores(logical = FALSE), error = function(e) NA_integer_)
if (length(n_detected_cores) == 0 || is.na(n_detected_cores)) {
  n_detected_cores <- tryCatch(parallel::detectCores(), error = function(e) 1L)
}
if (length(n_detected_cores) == 0 || is.na(n_detected_cores)) {
  n_detected_cores <- 1L
}
n_parallel_workers <- max(1L, as.integer(n_detected_cores) - 1L)
n_parallel_workers_env <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(Sys.getenv("ECI_PARALLEL_WORKERS", NA_character_)))
if (is.finite(n_parallel_workers_env) && n_parallel_workers_env >= 1L) {
  n_parallel_workers <- n_parallel_workers_env
}

parallel_map_with_progress <- function(X, FUN, ..., workers = n_parallel_workers,
                                       progress_label = NULL, chunk_size = NULL) {
  n <- length(X)
  if (n == 0L) return(list())
  workers <- as.integer(workers)
  if (length(workers) == 0 || is.na(workers) || workers < 1L) {
    workers <- 1L
  }
  if (is.null(chunk_size)) {
    chunk_size <- max(1L, workers)
  }
  chunk_size <- as.integer(chunk_size)
  if (length(chunk_size) == 0 || is.na(chunk_size) || chunk_size < 1L) {
    chunk_size <- 1L
  }

  results <- vector("list", n)
  chunk_starts <- seq.int(1L, n, by = chunk_size)

  if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
    cat(progress_label, "\n")
    pb <- utils::txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n, style = 3)
    on.exit(close(pb), add = TRUE)
  }

  for (chunk_start in chunk_starts) {
    idx <- chunk_start:min(chunk_start + chunk_size - 1L, n)
    chunk <- X[idx]
    chunk_start_time <- Sys.time()

    chunk_res <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" || workers <= 1L || length(chunk) == 1L) {
      lapply(chunk, FUN, ...)
    } else {
      parallel::mclapply(
        chunk, FUN, ...,
        mc.cores = min(workers, length(chunk)),
        mc.preschedule = TRUE,
        mc.set.seed = FALSE
      )
    }

    results[idx] <- chunk_res

    if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
      utils::setTxtProgressBar(pb, max(idx))
      elapsed_chunk <- round(as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), chunk_start_time, units = "secs")), 1)
      cat(sprintf("  completed %d-%d / %d (chunk %.1fs)\n", min(idx), max(idx), n, elapsed_chunk))
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(progress_label) && !quiet_output) {
    cat(sprintf(" %s done.\n", progress_label))
  }

  results
}

slope_or_na <- function(y, x) {
  ok <- is.finite(y) & is.finite(x)
  if (sum(ok) < 2 || length(unique(x[ok])) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  unname(coef(lm(y[ok] ~ x[ok]))[2])
}

scale_matrix <- function(df) {
  mat <- as.matrix(as.data.frame(lapply(df, as.numeric)))
  centers <- apply(mat, 2, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  scales <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  scales[!is.finite(scales) | scales == 0] <- 1
  out <- sweep(sweep(mat, 2, centers, "-"), 2, scales, "/")
  attr(out, "scaled:center") <- centers
  attr(out, "scaled:scale") <- scales
  out
}

first_non_na <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  x[1]
}
```

# Main And Structured Robustness Models

```{r}
make_panel <- function(df, years, spec = c("full", "reduced"),
                       drop_city_names = NULL, keep_city_names = NULL) {
  spec <- match.arg(spec)
  years <- sort(unique(as.integer(years)))

  out <- df %>%
    mutate(Year_calendar = as.integer(year)) %>%
    filter(Year_calendar %in% years)

  if (!is.null(drop_city_names)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(!(city_name %in% drop_city_names))
  }
  if (!is.null(keep_city_names)) {
    out <- out %>% filter(city_name %in% keep_city_names)
  }

  year_map <- data.frame(
    Year_calendar = years,
    Year_model = seq_along(years)
  )

  out <- out %>%
    left_join(year_map, by = "Year_calendar") %>%
    mutate(
      post = as.integer(Year_calendar >= policy_year),
      treatment = as.integer(yreb == 1 & post == 1),
      treated = treatment
    ) %>%
    arrange(Year_model, .data[[cluster_var]], .data[[id_var]])

  if (spec == "full") {
    x_vars <- full_x_vars
    nuisance_vars <- full_nuisance_vars
  } else {
    x_vars <- reduced_x_vars
    nuisance_vars <- reduced_nuisance_vars
  }

  list(
    data = out,
    x_vars = x_vars,
    nuisance_vars = nuisance_vars,
    years = years,
    spec = spec
  )
}

fit_cf_model <- function(panel, label, outcome = outcome_var, num_trees = cf_num_trees,
                         seed = 42, tune = TRUE) {
  df <- panel$data
  x_vars <- panel$x_vars
  nuisance_vars <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- unique(c(
    outcome, "treatment", x_vars, nuisance_vars, id_var, cluster_var,
    "Year_model", "Year_calendar", "city_name", "yreb", "post", "PROV", "near_ecrl_proxy"
  ))
  miss_cols <- setdiff(need_cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss_cols) > 0) {
    stop(paste("Missing columns in", label, ":", paste(miss_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }

  df <- df %>% filter(if_all(all_of(need_cols), ~ !is.na(.)))
  Y <- df[[outcome]]
  W <- as.numeric(df$treatment)
  X_df <- df[, x_vars, drop = FALSE]
  X <- scale_matrix(X_df)
  colnames(X) <- x_vars

  fmlY <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome, " ~ ", paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | near_ecrl_proxy + ", cluster_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  fmlW <- as.formula(paste0(
    "treatment ~ ", paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | near_ecrl_proxy + ", cluster_var, " + Year_model"
  ))

  mY <- feols(fmlY, data = df)
  Y.hat <- predict(mY)
  mW <- feols(fmlW, data = df)
  W.hat <- pmin(pmax(as.numeric(predict(mW)), 0), 1)

  clusters <- as.integer(factor(df[[cluster_var]]))
  cf <- causal_forest(
    X = X,
    Y = Y,
    W = W,
    Y.hat = Y.hat,
    W.hat = W.hat,
    clusters = clusters,
    num.trees = num_trees,
    equalize.cluster.weights = TRUE,
    honesty = TRUE,
    tune.parameters = if (tune) "all" else "none",
    min.node.size = 5,
    seed = seed
  )

  ate <- average_treatment_effect(cf, target.sample = "treated")
  est <- unname(ate[["estimate"]])
  se <- unname(ate[["std.err"]])
  z <- est / se
  p <- 2 * pnorm(-abs(z))
  ci_lo <- est - 1.96 * se
  ci_hi <- est + 1.96 * se

  pred <- predict(cf)
  df$ITE <- as.numeric(pred$predictions)
  vi <- data.frame(
    Variable = colnames(X),
    Importance = as.numeric(variable_importance(cf))
  ) %>% arrange(desc(Importance))

  summary <- data.frame(
    model = label,
    outcome = outcome,
    estimate = est,
    std_err = se,
    z_value = z,
    p_value = p,
    ci95_lo = ci_lo,
    ci95_hi = ci_hi,
    n_obs = nrow(df),
    n_units = n_distinct(df[[id_var]]),
    n_cities = n_distinct(df[[cluster_var]]),
    years = paste(panel$years, collapse = ","),
    forest_X = paste(x_vars, collapse = " + "),
    nuisance_controls = paste(nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    fixed_effects = paste("near_ecrl_proxy", cluster_var, "Year_model", sep = " + ")
  )

  list(
    label = label,
    panel = panel,
    data = df,
    X_df = X_df,
    X = X,
    x_center = attr(X, "scaled:center"),
    x_scale = attr(X, "scaled:scale"),
    Y = Y,
    W = W,
    Y.hat = Y.hat,
    W.hat = W.hat,
    clusters = clusters,
    cf = cf,
    summary = summary,
    vi = vi
  )
}

event_study_model <- function(panel, label) {
  df <- panel$data
  controls <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- c(outcome_var, "yreb", "post", controls, cluster_var, "Year_model", "Year_calendar")
  df_es <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(all_of(c(need_cols, "near_ecrl_proxy", "PROV")), ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
    transmute(
      id = .data[[cluster_var]],
      time = as.integer(Year_model),
      calendar_year = Year_calendar,
      Y = as.numeric(.data[[outcome_var]]),
      treat_city = as.integer(yreb == 1),
      post = as.integer(post == 1),
      near_ecrl_proxy = near_ecrl_proxy,
      PROV = PROV,
      across(all_of(controls), as.numeric)
    ) %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(T0 = ifelse(any(treat_city == 1 & post == 1), min(time[post == 1 & treat_city == 1]), NA_real_)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(k = time - T0)

  k_min <- suppressWarnings(min(df_es$k[df_es$treat_city == 1], na.rm = TRUE))
  k_max <- suppressWarnings(max(df_es$k[df_es$treat_city == 1], na.rm = TRUE))
  ref_k <- -1L
  ks_plot <- seq(k_min, k_max)
  ks_no_ref <- ks_plot[ks_plot != ref_k]
  event_name <- function(kk) if (kk < 0) paste0("dmin", abs(kk)) else paste0("d", kk)

  for (kk in ks_no_ref) {
    df_es[[event_name(kk)]] <- as.integer(df_es$treat_city == 1 & df_es$k == kk)
  }

  controls_within <- paste0(controls, "_within")
  for (j in seq_along(controls)) {
    df_es[[controls_within[j]]] <- resid(feols(as.formula(paste0(controls[j], " ~ 1 | id + time")), data = df_es))
  }

  rhs <- paste(
    c(sapply(ks_no_ref, event_name), controls_within,
      "factor(near_ecrl_proxy)", "factor(time)", "factor(PROV)"),
    collapse = " + "
  )
  m_es <- lm(as.formula(paste("Y ~", rhs)), data = df_es)
  Vcl <- sandwich::vcovCL(m_es, cluster = df_es$id, type = "HC1")

  pre_ks <- ks_plot[ks_plot < 0 & ks_plot != ref_k]
  lead_names <- sapply(pre_ks, event_name)
  lead_names <- lead_names[lead_names %in% names(coef(m_es))]

  wald_p <- NA_real_
  if (length(lead_names) > 0) {
    wald_res <- car::linearHypothesis(m_es, paste0(lead_names, " = 0"), vcov. = Vcl, test = "F")
    wald_p <- wald_res[2, "Pr(>F)"]
  }

  coef_names <- sapply(ks_no_ref, event_name)
  coefs <- stats::coef(m_es)[coef_names]
  ses <- sqrt(diag(Vcl))[coef_names]

  event_df <- data.frame(model = label, exposure = ks_plot, coef = NA_real_, se = NA_real_)
  event_df$coef[event_df$exposure != ref_k] <- coefs
  event_df$se[event_df$exposure != ref_k] <- ses
  event_df$coef[event_df$exposure == ref_k] <- 0
  event_df$se[event_df$exposure == ref_k] <- 0
  t0_model <- unique(df_es$time[df_es$treat_city == 1 & df_es$post == 1])
  t0_model <- min(t0_model, na.rm = TRUE)
  year_lookup <- panel$data %>% distinct(Year_model, Year_calendar)
  event_df <- event_df %>%
    mutate(
      ci_lo = coef - 1.96 * se,
      ci_hi = coef + 1.96 * se,
      Year_model = t0_model + exposure
    ) %>%
    left_join(year_lookup, by = "Year_model")

  p_event <- ggplot(event_df, aes(x = exposure, y = coef)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi), width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate(
      "label", x = Inf, y = Inf,
      label = paste0("Wald pre-trend p = ", format.pval(wald_p, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)),
      hjust = 1.02, vjust = 1.1, size = 3.5, label.size = 0.25
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Event time (baseline = -1)",
      y = "Treatment effect on ECI",
      title = paste0("Event Study: ", label)
    )

  list(
    coefficients = event_df,
    wald = data.frame(model = label, tested_leads = paste(lead_names, collapse = " + "), p_value = wald_p),
    plot = p_event
  )
}

did_model <- function(panel, label) {
  df <- panel$data
  controls <- panel$nuisance_vars
  need_cols <- c(outcome_var, "treatment", controls, cluster_var, "Year_model", "near_ecrl_proxy", "PROV")
  df_did <- df %>% filter(if_all(all_of(need_cols), ~ !is.na(.)))
  fml <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome_var, " ~ treatment + ", paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    " | near_ecrl_proxy + Year_model + PROV"
  ))
  m <- feols(fml, data = df_did, cluster = as.formula(paste0("~", cluster_var)))
  ct <- coeftable(m)
  data.frame(
    model = label,
    estimate = unname(ct["treatment", "Estimate"]),
    std_err = unname(ct["treatment", "Std. Error"]),
    t_value = unname(ct["treatment", "t value"]),
    p_value = unname(ct["treatment", "Pr(>|t|)"]),
    n_obs = nobs(m),
    n_units = n_distinct(df_did[[id_var]]),
    n_cities = n_distinct(df_did[[cluster_var]]),
    controls = paste(controls, collapse = " + "),
    fixed_effects = "near_ecrl_proxy + Year_model + PROV"
  )
}

fit_model_bundle <- function(label, years, spec = "full",
                             drop_city_names = NULL, keep_city_names = NULL,
                             num_trees = cf_num_trees, seed = 42,
                             include_did_event = TRUE,
                             tune = cf_tune_parameters) {
  panel <- make_panel(
    base_eci,
    years = years,
    spec = spec,
    drop_city_names = drop_city_names,
    keep_city_names = keep_city_names
  )
  cf_res <- fit_cf_model(panel, label = label, num_trees = num_trees, seed = seed, tune = tune)
  es_res <- if (include_did_event) event_study_model(panel, label = label) else NULL
  did_res <- if (include_did_event) did_model(panel, label = label) else NULL
  list(panel = panel, cf = cf_res, event = es_res, did = did_res)
}

print_bundle_results <- function(bundle) {
  invisible(bundle)
}

summarise_bundle <- function(bundle) {
  data.frame(
    model = bundle$cf$label,
    cf_att = bundle$cf$summary$estimate,
    cf_se = bundle$cf$summary$std_err,
    cf_p = bundle$cf$summary$p_value,
    did_att = bundle$did$estimate,
    did_se = bundle$did$std_err,
    did_p = bundle$did$p_value,
    event_pretrend_p = bundle$event$wald$p_value,
    n_obs = bundle$cf$summary$n_obs,
    n_units = bundle$cf$summary$n_units,
    n_cities = bundle$cf$summary$n_cities
  )
}

summarise_cf <- function(bundle) {
  data.frame(
    model = bundle$cf$label,
    cf_att = bundle$cf$summary$estimate,
    cf_se = bundle$cf$summary$std_err,
    cf_p = bundle$cf$summary$p_value,
    n_obs = bundle$cf$summary$n_obs,
    n_units = bundle$cf$summary$n_units,
    n_cities = bundle$cf$summary$n_cities
  )
}

main_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Main CF: 2017-2020 all-X",
  years = 2017:2020,
  spec = "full",
  seed = 42
)
print_bundle_results(main_bundle)

reduced_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Reduced-X CF: 2017-2020",

  spec = "reduced",
  seed = 42
)

full_year_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(

  spec = "full",
  seed = 42
)
print_bundle_results(full_year_bundle)

drop2019_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "Drop-2019 CF: 2017-2018 and 2020 all-X",
  years = c(2017, 2018, 2020),
  spec = "full",
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
print_bundle_results(drop2019_bundle)

structured_model_table <- bind_rows(
  summarise_bundle(main_bundle),
  summarise_bundle(reduced_bundle),
  summarise_bundle(full_year_bundle)
)
print(structured_model_table)
```

```{r}
gdp_change <- raw_pm %>%
```

# PSM Matched Sample

```{r}
psm_panel <- make_panel(base_eci, years = 2017:2020, spec = "full")
psm_covars <- c(
  "ECI_pre_1519", "ECI_trend_1519", "rainfall",
  "population_density_pre_1519", "built_share_pre_1519", "cropland_share_pre_1519"
)
psm_city <- psm_panel$data %>%
  filter(Year_calendar < policy_year) %>%
  group_by(city_name, city_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    yreb = max(yreb, na.rm = TRUE),
    across(all_of(psm_covars), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_psm"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_psm"), ~ ifelse(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x))) %>%
  filter(if_all(ends_with("_psm"), ~ !is.na(.)))

psm_covars_model <- grep("_psm$", names(psm_city), value = TRUE)
psm_fit <- glm(as.formula(paste0("yreb ~ ", paste(psm_covars_model, collapse = " + "))),
               data = psm_city, family = binomial())
psm_city$pscore <- predict(psm_fit, type = "response")

treated_ps <- psm_city$pscore[psm_city$yreb == 1]
control_ps <- psm_city$pscore[psm_city$yreb == 0]
ps_lower <- max(min(treated_ps), min(control_ps))
ps_upper <- min(max(treated_ps), max(control_ps))

treated_df <- psm_city %>%
  filter(yreb == 1, pscore >= ps_lower, pscore <= ps_upper) %>%
  arrange(pscore)
control_df <- psm_city %>%
  filter(yreb == 0, pscore >= ps_lower, pscore <= ps_upper) %>%
  arrange(pscore)

available_controls <- seq_len(nrow(control_df))
matched_pairs_list <- vector("list", nrow(treated_df))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(treated_df))) {
  if (length(available_controls) == 0) break
  diffs <- abs(control_df$pscore[available_controls] - treated_df$pscore[i])
  nearest_pos <- which.min(diffs)
  nearest_row <- available_controls[nearest_pos]
  matched_pairs_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    treated_city = treated_df$city_name[i],
    control_city = control_df$city_name[nearest_row],
    treated_cluster = treated_df$city_cluster[i],
    control_cluster = control_df$city_cluster[nearest_row],
    treated_pscore = treated_df$pscore[i],
    control_pscore = control_df$pscore[nearest_row],
    abs_diff = abs(treated_df$pscore[i] - control_df$pscore[nearest_row])
  )
  available_controls <- available_controls[-nearest_pos]
}
matched_pairs <- bind_rows(matched_pairs_list)
matched_city_names <- unique(c(matched_pairs$treated_city, matched_pairs$control_city))

psm_bundle <- fit_model_bundle(
  label = "PSM matched-sample CF",
  years = 2017:2020,
  spec = "full",
  keep_city_names = matched_city_names,
  seed = 42,
  include_did_event = FALSE
)
quiet_cat(sprintf("\nPSM matched pairs formed: %d\n", nrow(matched_pairs)))
quiet_cat(sprintf("PSM matched cities used: %d\n", length(matched_city_names)))
print_bundle_results(psm_bundle)

psm_summary_table <- summarise_cf(psm_bundle) %>%
  mutate(
    matched_pairs = nrow(matched_pairs),
    matched_cities = length(matched_city_names)
  )
print(psm_summary_table)
```

# Placebo, Falsification, And Bootstrap

```{r}
main_cf <- main_bundle$cf
data_main <- main_cf$data
X_main <- main_cf$X
cf_tuning <- main_cf$cf$tunable.params
treated_city_names <- data_main %>%
  filter(yreb == 1) %>%
  pull(city_name) %>%
  unique()
n_treated_cities <- length(treated_city_names)
all_city_names <- unique(data_main$city_name)
actual_att <- main_cf$summary$estimate

fit_cf_with_W <- function(W_local, outcome = outcome_var, treatment_name = "W_local",
                          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees, seed = 42) {
  df <- data_main
  df[[treatment_name]] <- as.numeric(W_local)
  if (length(unique(W_local)) < 2 || sum(W_local == 1) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                      n_obs = nrow(df), n_treated = sum(W_local == 1)))
  }
  fmlY <- as.formula(paste0(
    outcome, " ~ ", paste(main_cf$panel$nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | near_ecrl_proxy + ", cluster_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  fmlW <- as.formula(paste0(
    treatment_name, " ~ ", paste(main_cf$panel$nuisance_vars, collapse = " + "),
    " | near_ecrl_proxy + ", cluster_var, " + Year_model"
  ))
  mY <- feols(fmlY, data = df)
  mW <- feols(fmlW, data = df)
  cf_args <- c(
    list(
      X = X_main,
      Y = df[[outcome]],
      W = as.numeric(W_local),
      Y.hat = predict(mY),
      W.hat = pmin(pmax(as.numeric(predict(mW)), 0), 1),
      clusters = main_cf$clusters,
      num.trees = num_trees,
      equalize.cluster.weights = TRUE,
      honesty = TRUE,
      tune.parameters = "none",
      seed = seed
    ),
    cf_tuning
  )
  cf_local <- do.call(causal_forest, cf_args)
  ate_local <- average_treatment_effect(cf_local, target.sample = "treated")
  est <- unname(ate_local[["estimate"]])
  se <- unname(ate_local[["std.err"]])
  data.frame(
    estimate = est,
    std_err = se,
    p_value = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)),
    n_obs = nrow(df),
    n_treated = sum(W_local == 1)
  )
}

quiet_cat(sprintf("\nActual causal-forest ATT estimate: %.4f\n", actual_att))

B <- n_placebo
set.seed(42)
random_group_assignments <- lapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
  sample(all_city_names, size = n_treated_cities, replace = FALSE)
})

random_group_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(B),
    function(b) {
      tryCatch({
        placebo_treated_cities <- random_group_assignments[[b]]
        W_p <- as.numeric((data_main$city_name %in% placebo_treated_cities) & data_main$post == 1)
        fit_cf_with_W(
          W_local = W_p,
          treatment_name = "treatment_placebo",
          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
          seed = 42
        ) %>%
          mutate(iteration = b, placebo_type = "random_group")
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("Placebo iteration %d failed: %s", b, e$message))
        data.frame(iteration = b, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                   n_obs = NA_integer_, n_treated = NA_integer_, placebo_type = "random_group")
      })
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Random-assignment placebo progress (%d iterations)", B)
  )
)
random_group_results <- random_group_results %>% filter(!is.na(estimate))
random_group_percentile <- mean(random_group_results$estimate <= actual_att)
random_group_p <- mean(abs(random_group_results$estimate) >= abs(actual_att))

B_time_placebo <- n_placebo
placebo_year_pool <- c(2016L, 2017L, 2018L)
set.seed(42)
time_placebo_assignments <- lapply(seq_len(B_time_placebo), function(b) {
  sample(placebo_year_pool, length(treated_city_names), replace = TRUE)
})

time_placebo_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(B_time_placebo),
    function(b) {
      tryCatch({
        assigned_years <- time_placebo_assignments[[b]]
        city_timing_map <- data.frame(
          city_name = treated_city_names,
          placebo_start_year = assigned_years
        )
        placebo_start_vec <- city_timing_map$placebo_start_year[match(data_main$city_name, city_timing_map$city_name)]
        W_time_perm <- as.numeric(data_main$yreb == 1 & data_main$Year_calendar >= placebo_start_vec)
        fit_cf_with_W(
          W_local = W_time_perm,
          treatment_name = "treatment_time_perm",
          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
          seed = 42
        ) %>%
          mutate(iteration = b, placebo_type = "randomized_timing")
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("Randomized-timing placebo iteration %d failed: %s", b, e$message))
        data.frame(iteration = b, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                   n_obs = NA_integer_, n_treated = NA_integer_, placebo_type = "randomized_timing")
      })
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Randomized-timing placebo progress (%d iterations)", B_time_placebo)
  )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate))
time_placebo_percentile <- mean(time_placebo_results$estimate <= actual_att)
time_placebo_p <- mean(abs(time_placebo_results$estimate) >= abs(actual_att))

outside_yreb_cities <- data_main %>%
  filter(yreb == 0) %>%
  pull(city_name) %>%
  unique()
outside_yreb_pool_size <- length(outside_yreb_cities)
spatial_placebo_size <- min(n_treated_cities, outside_yreb_pool_size)
if (spatial_placebo_size >= outside_yreb_pool_size) {
  # The ECI sample has fewer non-YREB cities than treated YREB cities. Sampling all
  # non-YREB cities every time makes the placebo assignment deterministic, so use
  # random non-YREB subsets instead and report the reduced pseudo-treated size.
  spatial_placebo_size <- max(1L, floor(outside_yreb_pool_size / 2))
  warning(sprintf(
    "Spatial placebo candidate pool has only %d non-YREB cities vs %d treated cities; using random subsets of %d cities.",
    outside_yreb_pool_size, n_treated_cities, spatial_placebo_size
  ))
}

B_spatial_placebo <- n_placebo
set.seed(42)
spatial_placebo_assignments <- lapply(seq_len(B_spatial_placebo), function(b) {
  sample(outside_yreb_cities, size = spatial_placebo_size, replace = FALSE)
})
spatial_placebo_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(B_spatial_placebo),
    function(b) {
      tryCatch({
        pseudo_treated_cities <- spatial_placebo_assignments[[b]]
        W_spatial_placebo <- as.numeric((data_main$city_name %in% pseudo_treated_cities) & data_main$post == 1)
        fit_cf_with_W(
          W_local = W_spatial_placebo,
          treatment_name = "treatment_spatial_placebo",
          num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
          seed = 42
        ) %>%
          mutate(iteration = b, placebo_type = "spatial_placebo")
      }, error = function(e) {
        warning(sprintf("Spatial placebo iteration %d failed: %s", b, e$message))
        data.frame(iteration = b, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_,
                   n_obs = NA_integer_, n_treated = NA_integer_, placebo_type = "spatial_placebo")
      })
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Spatial placebo progress (%d iterations)", B_spatial_placebo)
  )
)
spatial_placebo_results <- spatial_placebo_results %>% filter(!is.na(estimate))
spatial_placebo_percentile <- mean(spatial_placebo_results$estimate <= actual_att)
spatial_placebo_p <- mean(abs(spatial_placebo_results$estimate) >= abs(actual_att))

alternative_region_results <- spatial_placebo_results

set.seed(42)
bootstrap_city_samples <- lapply(seq_len(n_bootstrap), function(i) {
  sample(all_city_names, length(all_city_names), replace = TRUE)
})
bootstrap_results <- bind_rows(
  parallel_map_with_progress(
    seq_len(n_bootstrap),
    function(i) {
      sampled_cities <- bootstrap_city_samples[[i]]
      boot_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(sampled_cities), function(j) {
        tmp <- data_main %>% filter(city_name == sampled_cities[j])
        tmp$boot_city_id <- paste0(sampled_cities[j], "_", j)
        tmp[[cluster_var]] <- tmp$boot_city_id
        tmp
      }))
      panel_boot <- main_cf$panel
      panel_boot$data <- boot_df
      res <- tryCatch(
        fit_cf_model(panel_boot, label = paste0("bootstrap_", i), num_trees = cf_fast_num_trees,
                     seed = 42, tune = FALSE),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      if (is.null(res)) {
        data.frame(iteration = i, estimate = NA_real_, std_err = NA_real_, p_value = NA_real_)
      } else {
        res$summary %>%
          transmute(iteration = i, estimate = estimate, std_err = std_err, p_value = p_value)
      }
    },
    workers = n_parallel_workers,
    progress_label = sprintf("Bootstrap progress (%d iterations)", n_bootstrap)
  )
)
bootstrap_summary <- bootstrap_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_estimate = mean(estimate),
    sd_estimate = sd(estimate),
    ci95_lo = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
    ci95_hi = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
    p_bootstrap = 2 * min(mean(estimate >= 0), mean(estimate <= 0))
  )

placebo_bootstrap_table <- bind_rows(
```

# Heterogeneity

```{r}
label_map <- c(
  rainfall = "Rainfall",
  population_density_km2 = "Population density",
  built_share = "Built-up share",
  cropland_share = "Cropland share",
  ECI_pre_1519 = "Pre-policy ECI",
  ECI_trend_1519 = "Pre-policy ECI trend",
  population_density_pre_1519 = "Pre-policy population density",
  built_share_pre_1519 = "Pre-policy built-up share",
  cropland_share_pre_1519 = "Pre-policy cropland share"
)

std_with <- function(df_mat_like, cf_res = main_cf) {
  as.matrix(sweep(sweep(df_mat_like, 2, cf_res$x_center, "-"), 2, cf_res$x_scale, "/"))
}

pdp_cf <- function(cf_res, var, ci_boot = pdp_ci_boot, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  Xdf <- cf_res$X_df
  grid <- unique(sort(as.numeric(quantile(Xdf[[var]], seq(0.05, 0.95, length.out = 21), na.rm = TRUE))))
  all_pred <- lapply(seq_along(grid), function(k) {
    Xk <- Xdf
    Xk[[var]] <- grid[k]
    tau_hat <- predict(cf_res$cf, newdata = std_with(Xk, cf_res))$predictions
    data.frame(grid = grid[k], id = seq_along(tau_hat), tau = as.numeric(tau_hat))
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  pdp <- all_pred %>%
    group_by(grid) %>%
    summarise(tau_mean = mean(tau, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  ids <- unique(all_pred$id)
  boots <- replicate(ci_boot, {
    boot_ids <- tibble::tibble(id = sample(ids, length(ids), replace = TRUE), boot_row = seq_along(ids))
    all_pred %>%
      inner_join(boot_ids, by = "id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      group_by(grid) %>%
      summarise(tau_mean = mean(tau), .groups = "drop") %>%
      pull(tau_mean)
  })
  pdp$ci_lo <- apply(boots, 1, quantile, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)
  pdp$ci_hi <- apply(boots, 1, quantile, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
  pdp %>% mutate(Variable = var, Label = unname(label_map[[var]]))
}

pdp_all <- bind_rows(lapply(main_cf$vi$Variable, function(v) pdp_cf(main_cf, v)))

city_ite <- main_cf$data %>%
  filter(treatment == 1) %>%
  group_by(city_name, city_cluster, PROV) %>%
  summarise(ATT = mean(ITE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

province_att <- city_ite %>%
  group_by(PROV) %>%
  summarise(ATT = mean(ATT, na.rm = TRUE), n_cities = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    PROV_plot = dplyr::recode(
      PROV,
      "上海市" = "Shanghai",
      "江苏省" = "Jiangsu",
      "浙江省" = "Zhejiang",
      "安徽省" = "Anhui",
      "江西省" = "Jiangxi",
      "湖北省" = "Hubei",
      "湖南省" = "Hunan",
      "重庆市" = "Chongqing",
      "四川省" = "Sichuan",
      "贵州省" = "Guizhou",
      "云南省" = "Yunnan",
      .default = PROV
    ),
    region = case_when(
      PROV %in% c("上海市", "江苏省", "浙江省", "安徽省") ~ "YRD",
      PROV %in% c("江西省", "湖北省", "湖南省") ~ "Midstream",
      PROV %in% c("重庆市", "四川省", "贵州省", "云南省") ~ "Upstream",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

region_att <- province_att %>%
  filter(region != "Other") %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(ATT = mean(ATT, na.rm = TRUE), n_provinces = n(), .groups = "drop")

heterogeneity_table <- bind_rows(
  main_cf$vi %>%
    transmute(section = "variable_importance", item = Variable, value = Importance, n = NA_integer_),
  province_att %>%
    transmute(section = "province_ATT", item = PROV, value = ATT, n = n_cities),
  region_att %>%
    transmute(section = "region_ATT", item = region, value = ATT, n = n_provinces)
)
print(heterogeneity_table)
```

```{r}
fig4_results_file <- "ECI_calendar_year_main_robustness_results.xlsx"
fig4_output_prefix <- "Fig4_ECI"

fig4_base_family <- "Arial"
fig4_base_font_size <- 10.5
fig4_panel_linewidth <- 0.28
fig4_out_width <- 13.5
fig4_out_height <- 7.38

fig4_label_map <- c(
  rainfall = "Rainfall",
  population_density_km2 = "Population density",
  built_share = "Built-up share",
  cropland_share = "Cropland share"
)

fig4_palette_hex <- c("#34A0A4", "#52B69A", "#76C893", "#B5E48C", "#E7F4B9")
fig4_level_cols <- c("City level" = "#84a354", "Unit level" = "#4895EF")

fig4_arial_pdf <- function(filename, width, height, ...) {
  grDevices::quartz(
    file = filename,
    type = "pdf",
    width = width,
    height = height,
    family = fig4_base_family
  )
}

fig4_theme <- theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = fig4_base_family),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "pt"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = fig4_base_font_size, hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", size = fig4_base_font_size, color = "black"),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 14, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = fig4_base_font_size, color = "grey40"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey50", fill = NA, linewidth = fig4_panel_linewidth),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "pt"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = fig4_base_font_size),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20", size = fig4_base_font_size),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(margin = margin(0, 8, 0, 0)),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(30, "pt"),
    legend.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, "pt"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = fig4_base_font_size),
    legend.text = element_text(size = fig4_base_font_size),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

fig4_main_data <- read_xlsx(fig4_results_file, sheet = "Main_data_with_ITE")

fig4_unit_effect <- fig4_main_data %>%
  filter(Year_calendar == 2020, treatment == 1, !is.na(ITE)) %>%
  transmute(Level = "Unit level", Level_id = 2, ITE)

fig4_city_effect <- fig4_main_data %>%
  filter(Year_calendar == 2020, treatment == 1, !is.na(ITE), !is.na(city_name)) %>%
  group_by(city_name) %>%
  summarise(ITE = mean(ITE, na.rm = TRUE), n_units = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  transmute(Level = "City level", Level_id = 1, ITE)

fig4_effect_data <- bind_rows(fig4_city_effect, fig4_unit_effect)

set.seed(42)
fig4_effect_points <- bind_rows(
  fig4_city_effect,
  fig4_unit_effect %>% slice_sample(n = min(800, nrow(fig4_unit_effect)))
)

fig4_effect_lims <- quantile(fig4_unit_effect$ITE, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
fig4_effect_lims <- c(floor(fig4_effect_lims[1]), ceiling(fig4_effect_lims[2]))

fig4_variable_importance <- read_xlsx(fig4_results_file, sheet = "Main_variable_importance") %>%
  mutate(Label = dplyr::recode(Variable, !!!fig4_label_map, .default = Variable)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
  mutate(Label = factor(Label, levels = rev(Label)))

fig4_top_response_data <- fig4_main_data %>%
  filter(Year_calendar == 2020, treatment == 1) %>%
  mutate(top_response = ITE >= quantile(ITE, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE))

fig4_top_response_table <- lapply(names(fig4_label_map), function(v) {
  top_vals <- fig4_top_response_data %>% filter(top_response) %>% pull(all_of(v))
  other_vals <- fig4_top_response_data %>% filter(!top_response) %>% pull(all_of(v))

  data.frame(
    Variable = unname(fig4_label_map[[v]]),
    raw_variable = v,
    TopQ = mean(top_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    Other = mean(other_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    p = t.test(top_vals, other_vals)$p.value
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    delta_pct = (TopQ - Other) / abs(Other) * 100,
    abs_lab = case_when(
      raw_variable == "rainfall" ~ sprintf("%+.1f mm", TopQ - Other),
      raw_variable == "population_density_km2" ~ sprintf("%+.1f people/km2", TopQ - Other),
      raw_variable %in% c("built_share", "cropland_share") ~ sprintf("%+.1f pp", (TopQ - Other) * 100),
      TRUE ~ sprintf("%+.1f", TopQ - Other)
    ),
    p_lab = case_when(
      p < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      TRUE ~ paste0("p = ", number(p, accuracy = 0.001))
    ),
    delta_lab = sprintf("%+.1f%%", delta_pct),
    label_x = if_else(raw_variable %in% c("rainfall", "cropland_share"), delta_pct - 5, 14),
    label_hjust = if_else(raw_variable %in% c("rainfall", "cropland_share"), 1, 0),
    label_y_shift = case_when(
      raw_variable == "population_density_km2" ~ 0.10,
      raw_variable == "built_share" ~ -0.10,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),
    Variable = factor(Variable, levels = rev(Variable)),
    y_num = as.numeric(Variable)
  )

fig4_panel_a <- ggplot(fig4_effect_data, aes(x = Level_id, y = ITE, fill = Level, color = Level)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_half_violin(
    side = "r",
    width = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.5,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.16)
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(group = Level_id),
    width = 0.15,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 1,
    position = position_nudge(x = 0.16),
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = fig4_effect_points,
    aes(x = Level_id - 0.06),
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, height = 0, seed = 42),
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.4,
    alpha = 0.20,
    stroke = 0.25
  ) +
  coord_flip(ylim = fig4_effect_lims) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fig4_level_cols) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fig4_level_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(1.15, 2.15),
    labels = c(
      paste0("City level\nn = ", nrow(fig4_city_effect)),
      paste0("Unit level\nn = ", nrow(fig4_unit_effect))
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Estimated policy effect on ECI") +
  fig4_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 23, 5, 5, "pt"))

fig4_panel_b <- ggplot(fig4_top_response_table, aes(x = delta_pct, y = y_num, fill = delta_pct)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "longdash") +
  geom_rect(
    aes(
      xmin = pmin(delta_pct, 0),
      xmax = pmax(delta_pct, 0),
      ymin = y_num - 0.4,
      ymax = y_num + 0.4
    ),
    color = NA,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_num + label_y_shift + 0.34, label = delta_lab, hjust = label_hjust),
    size = fig4_base_font_size / .pt,
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_num + label_y_shift, label = abs_lab, hjust = label_hjust),
    size = fig4_base_font_size / .pt,
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = label_x, y = y_num + label_y_shift - 0.34, label = p_lab, hjust = label_hjust),
    size = fig4_base_font_size / .pt,
    color = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = rev(fig4_palette_hex),
    limits = c(
      -max(abs(fig4_top_response_table$delta_pct), na.rm = TRUE),
      max(abs(fig4_top_response_table$delta_pct), na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    values = seq(0, 1, length.out = length(fig4_palette_hex)),
    guide = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1, scale = 1),
    limits = c(-110, 75),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = fig4_top_response_table$y_num,
    labels = as.character(fig4_top_response_table$Variable),
    position = "right",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.16, 0.16))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Percentage", y = NULL) +
  fig4_theme +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = fig4_base_font_size),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = fig4_base_font_size),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = fig4_base_font_size),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 12, 5, 18, "pt")
  )

fig4_panel_c <- ggplot(fig4_variable_importance, aes(x = Label, y = Importance, fill = Importance)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip(clip = "off") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = rev(fig4_palette_hex), guide = "none") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = number(Importance, accuracy = 0.01)),
    hjust = -0.2,
    size = fig4_base_font_size / .pt
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = max(fig4_variable_importance$Importance) * 1.10) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Importance") +
  fig4_theme +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5, 39.3, 5, 5, "pt"))

fig4_eci <- (fig4_panel_a + fig4_panel_b) / (fig4_panel_c + plot_spacer()) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.18, 0.765), heights = c(1.15, 1.32), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("a", "b", "c")))

ggsave(
  paste0(fig4_output_prefix, ".pdf"),
  fig4_eci,
  height = fig4_out_height,
  width = fig4_out_width,
  device = fig4_arial_pdf
)

ggsave(
  paste0(fig4_output_prefix, ".png"),
  fig4_eci,
  height = fig4_out_height,
  width = fig4_out_width,
  dpi = 900,
  bg = "white"
)
```
